messages:
anya: Quick design review — compact diff filter state seems to reset when you switch between eval runs. Repro: open run A, apply filters (Only failed, tag=nlp), switch to run B, come back to A and filters are gone. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/test.png
kevin: ugh. I saw that too. It's intermittent for me (only after quick nav).
lei: thanks for catching. Is this the sidebar or top filter pill? I thought we persisted via URL params
anya: sidebar. Looks like we add params for run id but not for filters. Quick snippet I added in console:
```js
// p: we read runId from qs but not filterState
const qs = new URLSearchParams(location.search)
const run = qs.get('run')
// filterState missing -> default
```
kevin: if it's missing from URL then we should persist to localStorage + restore on mount? but that won't work across devices
mike (product): prefer URL so links are shareable
lei: agreed — make filter state serializable into the query. maybe compress with base64 to avoid super long URLs
anya: accessibility nit — when filters collapse there is no aria-expanded change, VoiceOver doesn't announce the new state
kevin: filed a quick bug: JIRA-2147
mike (product): design question: which filters are global vs run-scoped? tag filters probably global, run-specific metric thresholds should be run-scoped
anya: propose: persist tag/user/label filters in query/global, metric thresholds in run-only key (e.g. runFilter_<id>)
lei: UX: rename 'Only failed' -> 'Show failures only' — clearer for screen readers and less ambiguous
kevin: copy tweak sounds good
mike (product): can we ship a small patch that keeps filter state on run nav + adds aria attrs? we can follow up with query param migration later
anya: I'll mock the change and post screenshots in #product-design later
mike (product): prioritize accessibility fix first. :thumbsup:
bot-deploy: staging deploy succeeded: 2024-04-03T21:10:12Z
anya: deployed to staging, ping me if you see regressions
lei: quick question — does this affect compact diff 'approve all' keyboard shortcut? might rely on filter state to compute selection
kevin: good call. added an e2e test; it's failing now, will fix in the PR
mike (product): timeline? next patch release?
kevin: aiming EOD tomorrow
anya: great, will review screenshots + microcopy then
mike (product): thanks team!
